prior_native_evidence.scope: V2 exact process recovery PASS at receipt time only; native security unchanged

checks_executed.executor: ChatGPT functions.exec independent JavaScript readback validator over exact GitHub source files
checks_executed.method_limit: Textual/lexical source invariants only; not C# compilation, executable integration, Windows token qualification, or fully independent third-party adjudication

threat_model_scope.broker_graceful_stop: Protected explicit three-principal DACL; only service thread owns pipe; asynchronous accept/read/write; stop event + CancelIoEx; OnStop bounded join; READ before RunAsClient; no file write operations
threat_model_scope.worker_handle_DACL: Connected worker PipeAccessRights.ReadWrite handle; GetSecurityInfo(handle,SE_FILE_OBJECT=1,DACL_SECURITY_INFORMATION=4), LocalFree, exact ACE/SID/mask checks, forbidden create-instance/WRITE_DAC/WRITE_OWNER; separate directory rights & SQLite write denied, SID peer handshake
threat_model_scope.sensitive_data: No passwords, raw security descriptors, SQLite contents or F0 data written or committed

known_unresolved: Win32 CancelIoEx only requests cancellation; pending APM completion and OnStop may still fail. Native Windows idle/stalled-client stop scenarios must be independently tested.
Worker V4 async read timeout/cancel error paths require Windows native test; script does not guarantee completion under every OS/driver condition.
Exact DACL ACE mask equality may be normalized by Windows/.NET; must fail closed on mismatch and investigate, not weaken controls.
LocalService, service SID, worker impersonation and DACL behavior are untested with new source.
Native Windows .NET Framework csc compilation and standalone Python static checker execution are not performed.
next_gate: Independent local Windows Python static QA with exact source pins and negative mutants; after PASS, separate exact Windows C# compile-only gate. No SCM install/switch/start in either step.
